newsitem.title: UK: British boy who fled to Malaysia vanishes again.
newsitem.headline: British boy who fled to Malaysia vanishes again.

text.p: A 15-year-old British boy who flew to Malaysia last year using his father's passport and credit card has vanished again, police said on Tuesday.
Police said they believe Peter Kerry may have headed for Europe and they are "increasingly concerned" about his safety.
Kerry, who prompted a six-day worldwide search when he fled from home after a family argument, has now left with his own passport, some money and a change of clothing.
The teenager, last seen at the weekend, wants to become an airline pilot. He has run away from home several times before, once to Paris and another time to Edinburgh.
He was given a 12-month conditional discharge when he admitted eight charges following his trip to Malaysia.
A court was told he had altered the photograph and date of birth on his father's passport and used his credit card to pay for flights and hotel accomodation.
